import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static int n, m, r, c, d;
    static int[] occ = new int[100];
    static Pair[] p = new Pair[100];

    static class Pair {
        int first, second;
        Pair(int first, int second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }
    }

    static class MinCostFlow {
        static final int N = 10000;
        static final int M = 20000000;
        static int[] head = new int[N];
        static int edge_idx;
        static int[] dist = new int[N];
        static int[] prev_node = new int[N];
        static int[] prev_edge = new int[N];
        static int S, T, total_cost;
        static Edge[] edges = new Edge[M];

        static class Edge {
            int to, next, capacity, cost;
            Edge(int to, int next, int capacity, int cost) {
                this.to = to;
                this.next = next;
                this.capacity = capacity;
                this.cost = cost;
            }
        }

        static void add_edge(int u, int v, int cap, int cst) {
            edges[edge_idx] = new Edge(v, head[u], cap, cst);
            head[u] = edge_idx++;
            edges[edge_idx] = new Edge(u, head[v], 0, -cst);
            head[v] = edge_idx++;
        }

        static boolean spfa() {
            Arrays.fill(dist, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
            dist[S] = 0;
            boolean[] in_q = new boolean[N];
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(S);
            in_q[S] = true;
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                in_q[u] = false;
                for (int i = head[u]; i != -1; i = edges[i].next) {
                    if (edges[i].capacity > 0 && dist[edges[i].to] > dist[u] + edges[i].cost) {
                        dist[edges[i].to] = dist[u] + edges[i].cost;
                        prev_node[edges[i].to] = u;
                        prev_edge[edges[i].to] = i;
                        if (!in_q[edges[i].to]) {
                            in_q[edges[i].to] = true;
                            q.offer(edges[i].to);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (dist[T] == Integer.MAX_VALUE) return false;
            int flow = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            for (int v = T; v != S; v = prev_node[v]) {
                flow = Math.min(flow, edges[prev_edge[v]].capacity);
            }
            total_cost += dist[T] * flow;
            for (int v = T; v != S; v = prev_node[v]) {
                edges[prev_edge[v]].capacity -= flow;
                edges[prev_edge[v] ^ 1].capacity += flow;
            }
            return true;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        r = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        Arrays.fill(MinCostFlow.head, -1);
        MinCostFlow.edge_idx = 0;

        int R = r + n + 1;
        MinCostFlow.S = R * n + 1;
        MinCostFlow.T = R * n + 2;

        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 1; i <= r; i++) {
            int x = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            occ[x]++;
        }

        p = new Pair[m + 1];
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int first = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            int second = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            p[i] = new Pair(first, second);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < r + n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
                for (int k = 1; k <= r; k++) {
                    int u1 = i * n + p[j].first;
                    int v1 = (i + 1) * n + p[j].second;
                    MinCostFlow.add_edge(u1, v1, 1, (2 * k - 1) * d);

                    int u2 = i * n + p[j].second;
                    int v2 = (i + 1) * n + p[j].first;
                    MinCostFlow.add_edge(u2, v2, 1, (2 * k - 1) * d);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= r + n; i++) {
            int from = i * n + 1;
            MinCostFlow.add_edge(from, MinCostFlow.T, Integer.MAX_VALUE, i * c);
            for (int j = 2; j <= n; j++) {
                int u = (i - 1) * n + j;
                int v = i * n + j;
                MinCostFlow.add_edge(u, v, Integer.MAX_VALUE, 0);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            MinCostFlow.add_edge(MinCostFlow.S, i, occ[i], 0);
        }

        while (MinCostFlow.spfa());

        System.out.println(MinCostFlow.total_cost);
    }
}
